{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''complex''' was one of the headquarters of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. It was carved into the interior of the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Salaktori Anchorage/Legends|Salaktori Anchorage]] and provided room and board for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] was based in this complex and often conducted his business in an ornate hall, complete with a [[memory bone chamber]].
